videos.scope: 本課「二維半導體轉移與接觸」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「單層與晶粒：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「接觸抽取：建立模型」列為查證任務：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Contact extraction: construct and analyze: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.

guides.title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「單層與晶粒：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜單層與晶粒：建立模型：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
觀察站 2｜接觸抽取：建立模型：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
觀察站 3｜晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證：高覆蓋率不等於高功能良率；形貌良率不涵蓋接觸及介電缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
Observation station 2 | Contact extraction: construct and analyze: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
Observation station 3 | Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify: High coverage yield is not high functional yield; Morphology yield omits contact and dielectric failures.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸抽取：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contact extraction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

diagram.titleEn: Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts: concepts and evidence

courses.overview: 從「二維半導體轉移與接觸」延伸比較源汲極接觸電阻控制、互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts by comparing Source-drain contact resistance control and Complementary FET research process flows: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 二維通道與一般接觸工程都可能受金屬／半導體界面及載子注入限制，需把接觸與通道電阻分開。
related.transferEn: Two-dimensional channels and contact engineering can both be injection-limited at metal/semiconductor interfaces, requiring separation of contact and channel resistance.
related.difference: 二維材料對轉移殘留、界面損傷及接觸幾何特別敏感；傳統體材料的接觸模型不能不驗證就套用。
related.differenceEn: Two-dimensional materials are especially sensitive to transfer residue, interface damage and contact geometry; bulk-material contact models need validation.
practice: 畫通道與兩端接觸的電阻分解。
比較不同間距測試結構的截距與斜率。
列出轉移前後需固定的材料與量測條件。
practiceEn: Draw channel and two-contact resistance decomposition.
Compare intercepts and slopes of different-spacing structures.
List material and measurement conditions to hold fixed across transfer.
related.title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制

related.why: 二維通道與一般接觸工程都可能受金屬／半導體界面及載子注入限制，需把接觸與通道電阻分開。
related.whyEn: Two-dimensional channels and contact engineering can both be injection-limited at metal/semiconductor interfaces, requiring separation of contact and channel resistance.

related.transfer: 二維材料與堆疊互補器件研究都受垂直整合、接觸與既有層熱預算限制。
related.transferEn: Two-dimensional materials and stacked complementary-device research share vertical-integration, contact and existing-layer thermal-budget constraints.
related.difference: CFET 的上下 n/p 器件安排不必採二維材料；二維轉移成功也不證明已完成互補電路。兩者是可比較的研究路線而非同義詞。
related.differenceEn: CFET n/p stacking need not use 2D materials; successful 2D transfer does not prove complementary circuitry. They are related research routes, not synonyms.
practice: 畫上層處理對下層元件的影響路徑。
比較 n/p 配對、接觸與對準三項需求。
訂定單元件展示與互補整合的不同驗收。
practiceEn: Draw paths by which top-layer processing affects lower devices.
Compare n/p pairing, contacts and alignment requirements.
Define distinct acceptance criteria for single-device demonstrations and complementary integration.

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
